### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **9** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`  _(via customer_service (literal, a string literal in MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **224** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **161** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **161**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **57** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f61e4f8fb567160f839c3269ee95aa89ee4f1db` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bc18935fd13ce97ee0fbf71c6bb78c1638c34ec2` — the merge of head `f7a05c860076e8b9af72c5ac07a215036c565e9b` into base `3f61e4f8fb567160f839c3269ee95aa89ee4f1db`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bc18935fd13ce97ee0fbf71c6bb78c1638c34ec2 && git checkout bc18935fd13ce97ee0fbf71c6bb78c1638c34ec2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 3f61e4f8fb567160f839c3269ee95aa89ee4f1db f7a05c860076e8b9af72c5ac07a215036c565e9b && git checkout -B drift-repro 3f61e4f8fb567160f839c3269ee95aa89ee4f1db && git merge --no-ff f7a05c860076e8b9af72c5ac07a215036c565e9b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 3f61e4f8fb567160f839c3269ee95aa89ee4f1db
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 3f61e4f8fb567160f839c3269ee95aa89ee4f1db` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f7a05c860076e8b9af72c5ac07a215036c565e9b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/marketplace/taxonomy.test.ts, .changeset/31066-taxonomy-identifiers.md, .changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md, packages/cli/test/package-publish-taxonomy.test.ts, docs/qa/scenarios/requisition_to_receipt.json, docs/qa/scenarios/service_desk.json, content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx, content/docs/references/marketplace/marketplace.mdx, content/docs/references/marketplace/package.mdx, content/docs/references/marketplace/taxonomy.mdx, content/docs/references/marketplace/template-manifest.mdx; cited code read, not reviewed: packages/spec/src/shared/identifiers.zod.ts (`SystemIdentifierSchema`), packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts (`SelectOptionSchema`), packages/spec/src/shared/lazy-schema.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts, packages/spec/liveness/template_manifest.json, the three connector manifests, docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md, scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs

Reviewed 2026-11-07T03:38Z on PR #31078 for card #31066, under the ruling 「spec 改成下划线（推荐）」 (record 6699866072 on #30904). Tier and face: `record-recognisers --template --paths` on the PR's twelve paths prescribes the schema face (`taxonomy.zod.ts` is a published schema) at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the PR's own declaration (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`) is the narrowing face, which maps to the same tier, so this record serves `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and its Scope is the whole diff outside the prose faces, the floor the narrowing face would set anyway. Inputs: the card body and comments, #30904's taxonomy ruling comment (tables 3.1 / 3.2 / 3.3) and the respell ruling record, the PR body, file list and `git diff origin/main...f7a05c86`, ADR-0087, `check-empty-changeset.mjs`, the npm publish record of `@objectstack/spec`, and the head's check-runs read once. The dev's report and the seat's claim were not used as evidence.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Exactly seven values move; order and cardinality hold.** At the head `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema` is 11 values and `MarketplaceIndustrySchema` 10, each in the base order, with `customer_service`, `supply_chain`, `trade_distribution`, `professional_services`, `financial_services`, `public_sector` and `real_estate_construction` the only changed members; `MarketplaceSolutionTypeSchema` (3) and `PackageMaturitySchema` (2) are untouched, and `MAX_BUSINESS_FUNCTIONS` / `MAX_INDUSTRIES` stay 3. `git grep` of the seven hyphenated spellings on the head hits only the new changeset's FROM/TO table and an unrelated `supply-chain` comment in `release.yml`; the connector manifests, `packages/spec/liveness/template_manifest.json`, `skills/**` and the other scenario cards never carried one.
- **Legacy category KEYS stay hyphenated, rightly.** `developer-tools` and `ui-theme` in `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` are the retired `category` values as authors wrote them (table 3.1 rows), looked up by string by the CLI refusal and the cloud migration; they are inputs written in the wild, never select option values, and the respell does not reach them.
- **`LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` matches 3.1 / 3.2 under the new spelling.** Table 3.1 gives `erp → [finance, supply-chain]`; the head writes `['finance', 'supply_chain']`. No other row of 3.1 or 3.2 names a respelled value (every other mapped row resolves to `sales`, `marketing`, `hr`, `finance`, `project`, `collaboration`, `administration` or `it`), so the table is consistent. `businessFunctions` on a `mapped` row is typed `readonly MarketplaceBusinessFunction[]`, so a stale spelling in the table is a tsc error, not only a test failure.
- **The guard covers every enum in the module and cannot pass vacuously.** The module has exactly four `z.enum` constructs and no `z.literal` / `z.union` facet. The walk over `Object.entries(Taxonomy)` reads `.options`, which the `lazySchema` Proxy resolves on first property access (under `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1` there is no Proxy), so all four are found and the array schemas, the mapping table and the constants fall out of the filter. The floor asserts `arrayContaining` of the four names and a value count of at least 26 (= 11 + 10 + 3 + 2), then parses each value with `SystemIdentifierSchema` (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]*$`, min 2) and as a full `SelectOptionSchema` `{ label, value }`. An enum added later is judged without being listed; a walk that finds nothing fails the floor.
- **No published spec carried the hyphenated values.** `npm view @objectstack/spec time`: 178 versions, the newest `18.3.0` at 2026-11-03T15:15Z and none after it; `dist-tags` are `latest: 18.3.0`, `next: 18.2.0`. #30980 merged as `468e0c16` at 2026-11-06T18:46Z; no tag contains it, `packages/spec/package.json` on main is still `18.3.0`, and `.changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md` is still pending. The new `next` snapshot lane (#30799) has published nothing since.
- **The no-RETIRED-entry reasoning holds under ADR-0087.** A ledger entry is a released-to-released prescription (a tombstone names the npm release it ships in). From `18.3.0` the only authored change is `category → facets`, which `marketplace-category-retired` (present at the merge base, so `already-registered` is admissible) prescribes by pointing at `taxonomy.zod.ts` and `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING`, naming no value; its prescription text carries no hyphenated spelling, so it stays complete after this diff. A value-rename entry would prescribe a rename from a spelling no release ever accepted, the false-data case ADR-0087 keeps out of the ledger; `unpublished` is unavailable (`@objectstack/spec` publishes) and `no-migration-prescription` would be contradicted by the FROM/TO table. ADR-0087 itself notes that `already-registered` is checked only for resolve-and-predate, never for coverage; coverage was judged here and it holds.
- **The DELIBERATE CORRECTION is the right class and the corrected sentence is accurate.** `.changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md` exists on the merge base and was not added by this PR, so the foreign-changeset rule refuses the `M` row (job 128278568162: that refusal is the only red in Check Changeset; `check-adr-0087-registration`, the LEVEL AXIS and protocol lockstep pass in the same job). This PR falsified the note, so restoring it would put the false sentence back: the class is DELIBERATE CORRECTION, declared on the PR naming the note and quoting the sentence. Judged sentence by sentence: the only changed sentence lists the eleven business functions, before `… customer-service … supply-chain …`, after `… customer_service … supply_chain …`, same order and count as the head's enum; every other sentence of that note is byte-identical and still true (it names no industry value), and its frontmatter is unchanged and non-empty. This PASS on the same head is the seat's confirmation the gate's remedy names (landing-operations: a correction beside code changes is confirmed by the at-tier PASS record, never by a maintainer wait).
- **Semver and the declaration pair are right.** `@objectstack/spec: minor` with `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: seven accepted values of the metadata protocol an author writes in `objectstack.manifest.json` are refused and seven others accepted, a narrowing of the accept set relative to main, shipped as `minor` under the launch-window lockstep rule; `check-changeset-no-major` LEVEL AXIS confirms no moved package is graded `patch`. Only spec's published source moves; the CLI's refusal text follows through `MarketplaceBusinessFunctionSchema.options` with no CLI source change, so no CLI bump is owed.
- **Carriers.** Two scenario cards, the CLI taxonomy test (refusal text and wire body), the handbook example and the four regenerated reference pages carry the identifier spellings; the scenarios schema reads the spec enum, so no second list exists in this repo.
- **Consumers outside this repo, in the meantime.** objectstack-ai/cloud#3689 (open, head `d7dcd0dd`, pins `90523379`, which contains `468e0c16`) imports `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` from the spec at that pin in `package-taxonomy-v2-migration.ts`, so an `erp` row would be written as `finance, supply-chain` if its migration is applied before the pin moves, and hand-writes the literal `"supply-chain"` in a refusal sentence in `package-taxonomy.ts`; it stores `business_functions` / `industries` as free-form columns, verbatim. The PR body names cloud#3661 as the follow-up after its pin moves and calls #3689 "unaffected until that follow-up". See ③ S1.

### ② Semver level

`minor` on `@objectstack/spec` is right (see ①). The declaration pair `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` + `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` is right on the PR body and on the new changeset, and the corrected 30904 note keeps its own pair unchanged.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **S1 (should-fix) — the cloud follow-up disclosure understates #3689.** "Unaffected until that follow-up" is not quite true: at pin `90523379` cloud#3689 embeds the old spelling in two places a pin move alone does not correct — the hand-written `"supply-chain"` example in `packages/service-cloud/src/package-taxonomy.ts` (a refusal sentence that would then teach an author an invalid value), and any `business_functions` rows its v2 migration writes from `LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING` before the pin moves. Name both, on the PR body or on cloud#3661, as the follow-up's obligations: move the pin, rewrite the literal, and either sequence the migration's `--apply` after the pin move or re-map the seven spellings in stored rows. Nothing in this diff can fix it, which is why it is a disclosure gap, not a defect of the diff.
- **S2 (should-fix, nit) — the module doc contradicts the change it sits beside.** `taxonomy.zod.ts` still says "Renaming or removing one is an ADR-0087 retirement with a data migration", one paragraph after this PR renamed seven values with no retirement. The sentence is true of a released value; qualify it ("a released value") so the next reader does not take this diff as precedent for respelling a shipped one. The generated `content/docs/references/marketplace/taxonomy.mdx` follows via `check:generated --fix`.
- Check-runs on the head, read once: every run completed; all required contexts success; `Check Changeset` failure is solely the foreign-changeset refusal on `.changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md` judged above; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Spec property liveness` and `PR-body guards` success; nothing pending, so nothing NOT MEASURED.
- The PR is still a draft; not a contract matter.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main`: it takes no declared capability away at any consumer, because no release ever declared the hyphenated values; relative to `18.3.0` the author-facing contract after this PR is the same `category → facets` step `marketplace-category-retired` already prescribes, now with values a select can carry. It makes the spec's own refusal real: `SelectOptionSchema.value` is `SystemIdentifierSchema`, so before this change the taxonomy could not be its own select options and cloud#3661 could not meet ruling §6 item 1; after it, the guard turns that invariant into a test rather than a convention. `taxonomy.zod.ts` holds against the ruling it implements (the 3.1 / 3.2 tables, with `erp` the one row that names a respelled value) and against its first consumers read in the cited code: the CLI publish path lists `.options` for its refusal and validates facets through the spec schema, and the cloud catalog reads the same table through its pin. Placing the respell inside the unreleased #30980 narrowing, with a corrected pending note rather than a second ledger entry, is the honest shape: the release note a reader of the next CHANGELOG sees lists the values that release accepts.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-07T03:40Z

Head-sha: `f7a05c860076e8b9af72c5ac07a215036c565e9b`
Implemented-by: `os-dev` (session `session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2`, branch `claude/issue-31066-taxonomy-identifiers`) · Reviewed-by: `repo:cloud#3`

- **形态：** 按裁决「spec 改成下划线（推荐）」，市场分类里 7 个带连字符的值改成下划线写法；顺序、个数都没变。`LEGACY_CATEGORY_MAPPING.erp` 跟着改。新加的守护测试把每个取值都按平台下拉选项值的规则解析，以后带连字符的值进不来。场景卡、CLI 测试、手册和生成的页面同步更新。
- **契约复核：** schema 面，PASS 6701761886。复核核实了 npm 上没有任何已发布的 spec 带过这些连字符值（最新发布的 18.3.0 早于 #30980 合并），所以不需要新增 ADR-0087 退役条目，这个判断成立。
- **席位确认「有意更正」：** 本 PR 改了尚未发布的 `.changeset/30904-marketplace-taxonomy.md` 里的取值列表。那份发布说明是本席位落地的 #30980 的，原文在本 PR 之后已经不对，更正正确，席位确认。Check Changeset 因此按设计保持红，它不在必需检查之列。
- **should-fix 去向：**
  - S1：cloud#3689 的迁移读的是改名前的映射表，`erp` 行会写成 `supply-chain`；上架拒收提示里也写死了 `"supply-chain"`。这两处转给 objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 的后续 PR：移 pin、改掉写死的值、把已存的连字符值重新映射。
  - S2：模块注释「改名或删除要按 ADR-0087 退役」应限定为「已发布的值」，转 #31035。
- **门禁：** spec、cli、scenarios、连接器全量通过；dogfood 3582 个通过；守护测试消融后变红。必需检查全部 success。
- **CLI 发版：** 本 PR 合并，是放行 CLI 的条件之一；另一个条件是 cloud#3661 后续 PR 的部署。
- **落地条款：** 非受治理面，复核 PASS 且必需检查绿 ⇒ 席位翻 ready、挂 auto-merge，经合并队列落地。
